[ BHS paryeṣṭi], search; seeking (esp. for food or a livelihood); seeking to obtain; Abh 428; D I 222, 9 (bahiddhā ~iṃ āpajjasi imassa pañhassa veyyākaraṇāya); A I 93, 18 (dve ’mā bhikkhave ~iyo … āmisapariyeṭṭhi ca dhammapariyeṭṭhi ca; cf Mp II 160, 26 : matthakappattā āmisapariyesanā āmisapariyeṭṭhi); Ja I 14, 32 (ussāho ca vāyāmo ca ~i tass’ eva samijjhati); Vibh 353, 14 (yā evarūpā āmisena āmisassa eṭṭhi gaveṭṭhi ~i esanā gavesanā pariyesanā ayaṃ vuccati lābhena lābhaṃ jigiṃsanatā; Vibh-a 485, 29 : ~ī ti punappunaṃ magganā); Peṭ 96, 19 (tassa ~i, katamassa dhammassa idaṃ nāmaṃ); Cp-a 23, 10 (mahāsatto pi tassa datvā puna ~iṃ anāpajjitvā ten’ eva pītisukhena vītināmesi); Kkh 2 50, 14 (itarathā hi pariyiṭṭhimatte yeva pārājiko bhaveyya, Be, Ee, Se so; Ce pariyeṭṭhita-; ≠ Sp 441, 21 : pariyiṭṭhamatten’ eva); — °- mūlaka , mfn. , having searching or seeking as its root; Tikap 169, 19 (attānaṃ ātāpeti paritāpeti pariyiṭṭhimūlakaṃ dukkhaṃ paccanubhoti); Spk III 54, 1 (~assa c’ eva paṭisandhimūlakassa ca dukkhassa vasena).
